description: What kinds of thing this farm keeps in its asset register. Until v0.162.0 this was a Select field on Asset Register and a tuple in three Python modules that had already drifted apart from each other; it is a register now, so adding 'Fuel Tank' is a record an operator creates rather than a release. THE DOCNAME IS THE TYPE NAME, which is what let every asset already on the site keep pointing at the same string when the column became a Link.

fields.description: What this kind of asset is called, exactly as it should read in a picker. IT IS ALSO THE DOCNAME — every Asset Register row points at this string — so renaming one here renames it on every asset that carries it.
fields.label: Type Name

fields.description: Untick to retire a type without deleting it. A retired type is kept off every picker and out of list_asset_types, and the assets already carrying it are untouched — which is the whole reason this is a flag and not a delete: removing the record would leave those assets pointing at nothing.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: An icon identifier for the map and the handset. The whole-farm map draws a lettered badge and uses the FIRST CHARACTER of this; iOS may read it as a symbol name. Left empty, the map falls back to the first letter of the type name, so a type nobody has given an icon still gets a pin.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: Where this type sits in a picker. Lower first; ties fall back to the type name, so a register where nobody has set one is in alphabetical order rather than in whatever order the rows were created.
fields.label: Display Order

fields.description: v0.205.0. People live or work in places of this type — a barn, a shop, a bunkhouse. Treated as OCCUPIED for programs with an occupied tier (rodent bait's strict tier). A Housing Unit whose unit type has the same name counts too. The per-place Occupied flag still applies on top.
fields.label: People Live or Work Here
Fixed Location
fields.description: It does not move: a wind machine, a well, a valve, a building. A scan never changes its position; moving it is an explicit, logged act. docs/design/badge_photo_and_fixed_assets.md Part B.
What belongs under this type, for whoever is choosing one.
fields.label: Description
Defaults for assets of this type
Has a Slope Limit
fields.description: v0.230.5. Machines of this type work ground with a safe-slope limit. Their Asset Register rows show Max Safe Slope, and the slope grade map colours ground against it. Data, not code: a new kind of machine is ticked here.

fields.label: Default Max Safe Slope (degrees)
fields.description: The cautious figure used for an asset of this type that has no limit of its own. Empty means each asset must carry its own.

fields.label: Default Service Interval (Hours)
fields.description: Given to a new asset of this type (or one moved to it) that has no hours interval yet, e.g. 50 for a mini excavator. Zero or empty: not on an hours schedule.

name: Farm Asset Type
